quests.title: New roots
quests.objective: Plant three seeds and leave the house by the garden door.
quests.beat: The first rows make the inherited place yours.
quests.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.
quests.opening: If this letter has found you, the house is yours. Start with three rows. A place becomes home through the small things you return to each morning.
quests.completion: Three rows, a little water, and a beginning. The next page names Mira at the seedhouse. Take your first harvest into town.

quests.title: First harvest
quests.objective: Harvest five crops and bring a basket to Mira’s counter.
quests.beat: Mira recognises an old seed variety and the farm’s name.
quests.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.
quests.opening: Those pale turnips came from your grandmother's seed tin. Bring in five crops when they're ready. I want to know which of the old varieties survived.
quests.completion: There they are. She kept these seeds through three lean winters. Keep a packet for next season. Elias has been asking who opened the farm.

quests.title: Meet the valley
quests.objective: Meet six residents at work or along their daily routes.
quests.beat: The player learns the town through people and useful places.
quests.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.
quests.opening: There are people here who remember the farm, and people who arrived after it closed. Meet six of us. You won't learn a valley from a map alone.
quests.completion: Now there are names behind the doors. Cleo could use a steady grower again. Speak to her about the kitchen deliveries.

quests.title: Market day
quests.objective: Earn 1,000 gold through the physical shipping bin.
quests.beat: Cleo puts the homestead’s produce on the kitchen menu.
quests.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.
quests.opening: The kettle is full, but my pantry isn't. Ship a thousand gold of produce from your crate. The morning cart still stops at the old gate.
quests.completion: Your vegetables made it onto today's menu. Rowan says the river crossing needs timber. Fix it and the cart can use the shorter road.

quests.title: The old bridge
quests.objective: Deliver twenty timber and fifteen stone to the bridge work site.
quests.beat: Repair opens a shorter route rather than a cosmetic quest flag.
quests.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.
quests.opening: The west footbridge has sound foundations and rotten boards. Twenty timber and fifteen stone will do it. I'll take the materials here and finish the crossing.
quests.completion: The new boards are down. No more picking through the riverbank. Orin found something in the conservatory while we were clearing the approach.

quests.title: Community garden
quests.objective: Craft three items and deliver six copper to the conservatory repair.
quests.beat: A functioning shared garden reveals a letter with a harbour stamp.
quests.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.
quests.opening: The garden frame is worth saving. Bring six copper, and get some practice at your workbench. Three finished pieces should tell us what you can handle.
quests.completion: The pipes hold. We found a letter tucked behind the old pump: a harbour stamp, four towns, and a promise to keep the winter cupboards full.

quests.title: The lantern promise
quests.objective: Supply the first village feast and meet the courier at Letter Court.
quests.beat: The old delivery ledger points beyond Dewhaven.
quests.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.
quests.opening: Before we ask the harbour for help, let's keep a promise here. Five turnips, three eggs, a trout, and flowers for the long table. Simple food, enough to share.
quests.completion: Aya brought the old delivery book to supper. Your grandmother's name is beside every winter run. Sera at Aster Quay has the other half of the ledger.

quests.title: Letters across water
quests.objective: Visit Aster Quay and examine Sera’s delivery ledger.
quests.beat: Winter food deliveries once connected all four towns.
quests.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.
quests.opening: I thought that farm mark had disappeared. Read the ledger on my workbench. The boats carried food inland before the cliff landing failed.
quests.completion: Your grandmother planned a route between four public kitchens. Basil can repair the landing winch. We could start with one safe crossing.

quests.title: Safe harbour
quests.objective: Repair the landing winch with four copper and ten timber.
quests.beat: A safe cliff landing becomes a visible route upgrade.
quests.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.
quests.opening: The brake has seized, but the frame is sound. Four copper and ten timber will make the landing usable. Then you can reach the archive beneath the cliffs.
quests.completion: Try the brake. It holds. The cliff landing is open, and Marin has the safest path to the old archive.

quests.title: Under the cliffs
quests.objective: Walk the Saltwind trail and inspect the vault’s water diagram.
quests.beat: The dungeon belongs to the coastal landscape and the delivery story.
quests.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.
quests.opening: Keep to the dry stair on Saltwind Cliffs. In the first room, read the water diagram before touching the wheels. The archive was built to work with the tide.
quests.completion: You've seen how the channels fit together. Sera needs the chart case beyond the pump, carts and salt lock. Take your time; the way out stays open.

quests.title: The tide remembers
quests.objective: Complete the Tide Vault and return its chart to the boatworks.
quests.beat: The chart reveals the orchard delivery route.
quests.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.
quests.opening: The coast changes with every storm. That chart is our missing record. Recover it from the case, and bring it here so we can read the orchard route.
quests.completion: Cedar Downs, then Sunridge. The orchard kitchens sent preserves on every autumn run. Keep the chart; you'll need all three instruments to rebuild the atlas.

quests.title: The orchard road
quests.objective: Follow Cedar Downs to Sunridge and visit the orchard kitchen.
quests.beat: The player finds the family that used to prepare the autumn cargo.
quests.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.
quests.opening: Sera wrote ahead. Come inside the orchard house. I kept the long table, even after the deliveries stopped. It seemed wrong to turn it into firewood.
quests.completion: We still have the table. Now we need a reason to fill it. Two jars of preserves and four ears of corn would make a start.

quests.title: A long table
quests.objective: Bring two preserves and four corn for the orchard table.
quests.beat: Neighbours start using the shared table again.
quests.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.
quests.opening: The orchard workers have been eating on the steps. Bring two preserves and four corn. We'll lay the table properly and leave room for late arrivals.
quests.completion: Ada stayed for seconds. Pavel even put his tools down. He knows the quarry gate, where the old weather lens was made.

quests.title: The quarry gate
quests.objective: Clear and repair the glassworks approach using six timber and ten stone.
quests.beat: The old industrial route becomes a real place to explore.
quests.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.
quests.opening: The glassworks road is buried under loose stone. Six timber for the supports, ten stone for the drain. I'll clear a safe approach to the freight lift.
quests.completion: The quarry drain is running again. The Ember Gallery is open. Orin can tell you which part of the weather instrument we're looking for.

quests.title: Warm glass
quests.objective: Recover the protected lens from the Ember Gallery.
quests.beat: The lens was made for weather instruments and safer winter travel.
quests.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.
quests.opening: A wrapped lens was left in the insulated chamber. Balance the lift, vent the cooling hall, then align the reflector. It is engineering, not a treasure hunt.
quests.completion: No chips in the glass. Excellent. Bring it to the weather bench here; the chart's markings will make more sense with the lens fitted.

quests.title: Reading the weather
quests.objective: Fit the lens to a bench instrument and compare its markings with the chart.
quests.beat: Observation and engineering explain the observatory’s purpose.
quests.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.
quests.opening: The bench needs two copper and a crystal mount. Fit them here, compare the coastal marks, and we'll know which route can carry winter supplies.
quests.completion: The lines meet at Briar Hollow. Ilan has your grandmother's unfinished atlas. Take both instruments to the archive.

quests.title: The unwritten atlas
quests.objective: Bring the chart and lens to the Briar Archive.
quests.beat: The atlas’s missing section is the upper mountain road.
quests.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.
quests.opening: She left the mountain section blank on purpose. An untested route is worse than an empty page. Vesper can reopen the sheltered upper stair.
quests.completion: The chart gives us distances; the lens gives us weather readings. We still need the observatory's compass. First, make the upper road safe.

quests.title: The upper road
quests.objective: Repair the sheltered stair with eight timber and two iron.
quests.beat: Wayfinding, rest landings and an escape route precede the climb.
quests.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.
quests.opening: Eight timber and two iron will give the stair solid rails. I won't send anyone up a route I can't bring them down from.
quests.completion: The rails and rest landings are ready. Read the gust markings before crossing the observatory platforms. The descent stays available throughout.

quests.title: The sky road
quests.objective: Complete the Observatory and recover the brass compass.
quests.beat: The three instruments form a practical map of the valley.
quests.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.
quests.opening: The observatory was a weather station. Open its shutters, seat the gears, and align the meridian plates. Bring back the brass compass in the final gallery.
quests.completion: Three instruments, at last. Jun wants to test the route against the map before a cart follows it. Start at the three survey points on Observatory Rise.

quests.title: A safe passage
quests.objective: Trace three marked route checks with Jun in one visit.

quests.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.
quests.opening: Don't wait for winter to find a bad landing. Check the three survey stations on the rise. Compare the slope, shelter, and return path at each.
quests.completion: The notes agree with the ground. Now the route needs people at both ends. Join the harbour, orchard, and archive tables so the hosts can plan together.

quests.completion: The kitchens have agreed on their part. Marin has a list of repairs for the four shared rooms. They should be ready before the first convoy.

quests.opening: Four rooms, four doors left open. Each host has a repair basket at their shared room. Timber, stone, and a little care will put them back into daily use.
quests.completion: The rooms are furnished and the cupboards are dry. Aya can label the first three supply crates at your farmhouse. After you pack them, let the morning cart do its work.

quests.title: The first convoy

quests.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.
quests.opening: At your shipping crate: pack one pantry box, one orchard box, and one repair box. I'll collect them at dawn. Meet me after the next morning's delivery.
quests.completion: All three crates arrived. Nothing lost, nobody stranded. Your grandmother started this route with a borrowed cart. We started it again with yours.

quests.completion: The atlas is finished, but the valley isn't. Crops still need water. Someone is setting another place at a table. Tomorrow, choose the part of this life you want to grow.
